extras: Pro features require GitHub sponsorship. Users must trust scripts run via Templater.
intentEvidence: Show Templater dynamic results beside the text you write in Live Preview.
problem: Users cannot easily see the dynamic output of complex template commands while editing notes in Live Preview.

relations.evidence: Templater must be installed and enabled.

summary: Displays dynamic results from Templater commands directly within the text when using Live Preview, allowing users to edit the source command easily.
